description: Equity Residential (EQR) is committed to creating communities where people thrive, and the Company, a member of the S&P 500, owns and manages rental properties in dynamic metro areas across the U.S., with ERP Operating Limited Partnership (ERPOP) focused on conducting the multifamily property business of EQR. EQR is a Maryland real estate investment trust formed in March 1993 and ERPOP is an Illinois limited partnership formed in May 1993, and EQR is the general partner of, and as of December 31, 2025 owned an approximate 97.6 percent ownership interest in, ERPOP, with all of the Company's property ownership, development and related business operations conducted through the Operating Partnership and EQR having no material assets or liabilities other than its investment in ERPOP. Its markets attract and create high quality jobs that are often focused in growing areas of the knowledge-based economy, and these jobs result in the significant presence and growth in renters that work in the highest earning sectors of the economy and are not rent-burdened.
